record.name: Vonage
record.one_liner: Vonage provides communication and network APIs for voice, video, messaging, verification, and network features.

auth.notes: Vonage uses a combination of API keys/secrets and JWTs for authentication across its various APIs as configured via the Application API.

access.notes: Users can create their account to get started with the Vonage Communication APIs.

api_surface.notes: Vonage offers REST APIs, Webhooks (such as Voice Webhooks), and numerous server-side and client-side SDKs.

mcp.notes: Vonage documentation mentions an MCP Server and MCP Server Documentation.

buildability.reasoning: Vonage features self-serve account creation, extensive documentation, Postman collections, SDKs, and a developer center with clear getting started guides.

evidence.claim: Vonage provides Voice, Video, Messaging, and Network Feature APIs with server and client SDKs.
The API reference lists multiple REST-based APIs including Messages, SMS, Voice, and Account management.
Documentation includes references to MCP Server, SDKs & Tools, and Postman Collections.
Developers can create an account to get started with Vonage Communication APIs.
Provides SDKs for Node.js, Python, Java, Kotlin, Ruby, PHP, and .NET, alongside MCP server documentation.
